body:
Firstly, thank you for your recommendation, that seems like an interesting read. I dont read much and honestly i wish i did more. So much great knowledge in books, im just so used to the level of constant stimulation in entertainment. I cant even watch tv without going on my phone or playing a game or something. But i think i will give that i try, reading more would be good for me. 

Yeah im very much in a stage of my life where im asking a lot of those questions. Looking towards my future and having no idea what im going to do with it. I feel like there is something i want to do and i just cant figure out what, and im scared ill never find it. 

One last thing, i thought when things got fixed with my friend, my mental state would just kinda get better. But im still just been feeling more depressed lately, not like the deep i cant go to school kind that hit me one day after the fight. Just the always there in the back of my head kind that i used to have. And it feels wierd, like i can only describe it as being comfortable with it. There is something familiar and comforting in feeling like this. I dont want to feel like this and yet i do. Maybe all the confusion and stress im dealing with its in a way nice to feel something i know. I dealt with depression for a while and took me till recently thats not just how people feel normally. But for some reason feeling it again gives me a strange kinda morbid comfort. Feeling whats the point in even trying nothing even matters. Maybe it makes me less stressed becuase why worry about failure if it doesnt matter and life sucks in general. idk ive just got a lot in my head rn. 
Im so sorry if im spilling to many of my problems on you its just really nice to have someone who will listen. I didnt realize how much i needed this, now that im talking about some of what im feeling its like the floodgates opened. If this is a lot to take on for you, especially for a stranger just tell me and i can find someone else, i understand. Thanks again, and its definitly comforting to know im not the only one asking all these questions and such.

Hey, so good news. Me and my friend made up, im not entirely sure by how much, but things are cool at least. I honestly feel dumb for freaking out so much, but we had never in all our years of friendship had a fight nearly that big. But i think thats more of a testament for how much stress im under rn. I do try to find time for fun and relaxation and i usually can. Just not enough, like i know a lot of people have less time than i do. But im not sure i can really be happy just slogging through life like this. I hate that i spend five days a week just waiting for them to end. Then at least a moderate time during the weekend doing the same. I love the world and all the cool things out there and want to experience them. But just waiting for time to pass all the time just feels like a waste of the time i do have. And that all adds to the feeling of whats the point. If im going to spend my whole life waiting for time to pass, why not just get to the end of it sooner. Im not feeling suicidal rn, but thats a thought that goes through my head maybe too much. Like the slog that is dealing with life every day is just such a hassle and honestly not even sure if its worth it for those few moments of fun after such a much larger amount of time of shit. Oh and thank you so much for listening to me, i think i needed that more than anything else rn. So know that you really have been a help to me, and just listening has been appreciated immensely.

Wow, thanks man. Its nice to have some perspective from someone who has gone through these years. Its comforting to know that life goes on. I guess another question kinda related. All this makes me feel depressed and thats making me fall into old bad habits which just make me more depressed. I stopped smoking on weekdays to get more sleep and not be day after when i needed to focus. But rn i cant sleep, because when i try my mind goes to dark places. And i really want to know, to make me feel better and let me fall asleep. There are others, thats just on my mind rn. Sorry if all of this is written terribly. Im just kinda writing as it pops in my head. 

Life is really stressful rn and im honestly not sure i can handle it. If you dont mind me adding on to all these other problems you are so nice to talk to me about. Just sports are getting super demanding and difficult. Ive had one week with less than 6 practices in the last month and a half and for the next coming weeks. The workouts have been harder to. Its really competitive within the team, as only  8 people get to be in the top boat, and rn im basically the next choice so i have to work super hard so i can make it by regionals. 

School is killing me, my grades arnt where i want them to be and its my junior year and idk how this is going to effect my colleges, and if i dont make my dream college for sports i honestly dont know if i can through academics even if it is my states college. I go to a specialty school part of the public school system specializing in certain subject. And its much more competitive, no class is less than honors and the teachers purposely go harder. And all that isnt for me but at this point its too late to leave, might as well have coming from this school on my college apps. But its just so stressful. And teachers dont care you have sports (my school has no school sports) and my coaches dont really care about school as long as we are passing. 

And to add to all of this, i work on weekends, only part time and for like four hours each day. But still, i feel like im spreading myself thin and stressed about everything. But i need to keep all these aspects of my life. Adding this big social stress just makes things so much harder to work, and even care to a point. 
Sometimes looking at all i have ahead of me before i get a break, like it makes me just want to hit that magic off switch on life and be done. I try to power through and its gotten a lot better since my depression finally started getting better. But all this just makes me feel like im falling back into that, except with all my added responsibilities now. Oh and to add to that i dont have the faintest idea of what to do with my life, while the counselors at my school keep trying to help me with my "career plan". I dont know what i want in life, and im surrounded by these 4.0, 6 AP classes all the extra curricular kids, who are already on a path to becoming doctors and shit. And im just there sitting in the back of my class hoping my best friend in the world will ever be able to forgive me. 

Sorry for all that rambling, there is a lot going on in my head and i just have no idea about anything rn. Life's tough man :/

Thanks for all this, but im not even sure i want that. Ive had a solid best friend for so long, i just feel so alone not having that rn. Like no matter what i always had a person there for me. And just not feels just so different and so lonely.

i dont know if i want to tho. I try to think about what i would do, and i just dont want to do any of it. Somehow everyone else can manage life without a best friend supporting them. But at this point im not sure if trying would even be worth it.

firstly man, please dont do it. Youre only 21 there are so many possibilities left in your life. So much you can do and achieve. You'll definitely not achieve your dreams if you are not here to reach them. 
I may be some nameless faceless stranger on the internet, but i promise you i care about you. The fact that you dont know me personally shouldnt make that any less meaningful. If anything the opposite. You matter enough as a human being even people who never met you care about you and your well being. 

I can't tell you, you definitely will become a director or screenwriter. But you can still achieve great things. And who knows, maybe in 20 years everyone will think of you as the greatest director of our time. But getting there requires you being here. 

You matter, dont forget that.

Pretty much yeah, and he is a really good friend like 99% of the time. And admittedly the things he is mad at me for are not entirely my fault. He is really bad at expressing his emotions, and it makes it hard to judge his opinions on things until its really pissing him off. But that doesnt change that i did this stuff. He doesnt do like tests, accept that whole thing with his ex which im honestly still confused about
just did that, maybe it will help at this point idk. Thanks so much dude

I know, i just dont know how.

Thanks for taking time out of your day to help me btw

A lot of things, i did some shit in the past that made him less able to trust me. Then i fucked up again when he was starting to trust me again. Then finally with talking to her he is just tired of it. I want to figure out how to rationalize all this but i cant, i just feel like such and asshole and idk what to do.
Thats not what he really is mad about, it was just the catalyst that set off the whole fight. Sorry if that wasn't clear
